blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following is false about the transition property in CSS?
Tap an option below to answer:
It allows you to control the duration and timing function of style changes on an element.
The transition property gives you control over property, duration, and timing-function, helping you fine-tune animations.
The transition property gives you control over property, duration, and timing-function, helping you fine-tune animations.
It starts only after some user interaction, like a hover or a click.
Transitions require a state change, such as hover or click, to initiate. They do not run automatically.
Transitions require a state change, such as hover or click, to initiate. They do not run automatically.
It will loop animations repeatedly until they are manually stopped.
Transitions only animate once between two states.
Transitions only animate once between two states.
It makes user interactions feel smoother and natural by providing visual feedback.
Transitions improve user experience by providing smoother, more responsive interactions.
Transitions improve user experience by providing smoother, more responsive interactions.
